title: "3. Call REDCap"

# Retrieve a REDCap report

The complete runnable programs are available on the **Code & Downloads** page.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## R

### Retrieve credentials

Read the REDCap URI and project token from the stored environment variables:

```r
redcap_uri <- Sys.getenv("redcap_uri")
token <- Sys.getenv("token_toy")
```

### Request the report

Use `REDCapR::redcap_report()` to retrieve the REDCap report.

```r
raw0 <- REDCapR::redcap_report(
  redcap_uri = redcap_uri,
  token = token,
  report_id = REPORT_ID
)$data
```

### Save the raw extract

Write the retrieved data to a dated CSV file in `DataRaw`.

The source extract should be preserved unchanged.

## SAS

### Retrieve credentials

The REDCap URI is retrieved from the stored env variable:  

```sas
/* REDCap URI */
%let redcap_uri=%sysget(redcap_uri);

/* Confirm that the token is available */
%put Token length=%length(%sysget(token_toy));
```

The API token is retrieved with `%sysget(token_toy)` when the request body is created.

### Build the request

```sas
data _null_;
    file req;

    put "token=%sysget(token_toy)"
        '&content=report'
        '&report_id=207931'
        '&format=csv'
        '&rawOrLabel=label';
run;
```

### Submit the API request

```sas
proc http
    url="%sysget(redcap_uri)"
    method="POST"
    in=req
    out=response
    ct="application/x-www-form-urlencoded";
run;
```

### Save the raw extract

The response is imported and saved unchanged in `DataRaw`.

:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Expected result

The toy REDCap report produces **100 records and 14 variables**. The source extract is saved in `DataRaw`.
:::
